resources.string: A map that grows with you.
Reveal new areas as you explore. Your location uncovers roughly one-mile map tiles; driving also adds roads and mileage.
A little preview. No location needed.
Tile revealed! This preview adds no real progress.

This is your tracking control. Allow Precise location to record roads. Automatic tracking is the default; choose manual tracking in Settings if you prefer.\n\nSet up while parked. Stop tracking from its notification.

Open Layers for Explore nearby: a grid showing which nearby tiles you have visited. You can also highlight towns, states or regions, and countries.\n\nThe location button above brings the map back to you.

Trips keeps your drives and animated replays. Badges shows achievements. Goals gives you weekly challenges. Forum opens the public community for discoveries and tips.\n\nWalking can uncover tiles too; driving earns road and mileage credit.
Earn points from new roads, achievements, and first visits to new places. Tap Garage to spend them on car styles, colors, and other cosmetics.

Settings has light and dark appearance, tracking options, backup and restore, and the privacy policy. Review location sharing under Data and privacy.\n\nReplay this guide anytime from Settings → Quick tour. An account is optional. If needed, setup follows the tour.
A quick guide to your map and tracking controls.
Leaving keeps your saved progress. Tracking can continue in the background, subject to Android’s location and battery settings. To stop recording, use Stop tracking in the notification.
Leaving keeps your saved progress. No tracking service is running right now.
